notes.title: Gameplay Issue After 26th June Update
notes.content: [p]Heroes of Dracania,[/p][p]After the update on 26th June, some players experienced issues with attacking monsters, particularly with armor‑breaking mechanics. This was caused by a recent adjustment intended to prevent the use of illegal cheats, which unintentionally affected normal gameplay.[/p][p]The team is actively working on a solution and will share an update as soon as a fix is scheduled.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and understanding.[/p][p]Your Drakensang Online Team[/p]

notes.title: Curse of the Immortals content update - out now!
notes.content:
The old scrolls tell of a time long past, where mighty immortals threatened to enslave the world until the races united under one banner and battled them back to the abyss. Yet now, the darkness stirs once more and with the world at war with itself, it needs a special hero to stand up to the fray!

This thrilling new content update features challenging new maps to uncover, including the Bastion of the Order city and the Greyling Forest, before entering the Primal Spark map for a grand battle against the fearsome, winged Paragon of Deceit. Other monstrosities drawn from the realms of the immortals are sent to terrorize the world, including: the unnerving Fiendish Slime, the ethereal Will-O'-the Wisp and the ferocious Ember Wolf.

But don’t despair, those brave enough to take on the challenge will be handsomely rewarded with powerful new items to equip their heroes, including the new Seeker’s Set. The Curse of the Immortals update also boasts new Rings, Runes and Jewels, a mysterious new Pet and much more!

Battle against the darkness and drive it back to whence it came in the Curse of the Immortals content update - the first iteration of Drakensang Online’s epic Immortal Saga. Break the Curse of the Immortals, earn riches galore and save Dracania from devastation once again!
